error:
TimeoutExpired(['bash', '-lc', 'set -e
echo '===USERS==='
find /mnt/c/Users -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
echo '===STARTUP_FOLDERS==='
find /mnt/c/Users -type d -path '*/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo '===WRITABLE==='
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -w "$p" ] && echo "WRITABLE:$p" || echo "READONLY:$p"; done < <(find /mnt/c/Users -type d -path '*/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20)'], 120)
